independence.statement: Independent reviewer; no participation in task08 design, implementation, tests or RCA, and no delegation. Review verification includes the requested physical scope check and a small read-only sample audit.

rulings: C is the current HEAD and its sole parent is BASE; feat/iter-11-reliable-delivery is the iteration branch. The tracked worktree was clean at inspection. All changed files are task scope or the implicitly permitted task card; no root index or product files changed.

Compared BASE to C: frozen objective, type, interfaces, scope, acceptance and iteration goal remain unchanged; only allowed metadata, checkmarks and ledger were updated. Card is TESTING/PENDING with empty head_sha and no delivery_mode, thus Git under the legal default; no filesystem profile fallback is involved.

Spike-Discovery experiment, decision and interfaces are supplied. No RED is required or claimed. Candidate uses real audit, real Git and filesystem byte comparison; sample checks and reviews are explicitly synthetic, not execution or business approvals.

Four workload roots retain 10/100 cards and corresponding receipts. Code audits every card and checks board accepted equals N before timing; generated Git per-card base/C/registration and FS manifest, snapshots, contract and goal are read by real binding validators. Source drift and neighboring-card preservation were tested in both modes. Eight first/last cards were independently re-audited with a unique runner receipt.

The complete 2 modes x 2 sizes x 4 operations x 3 trials is recorded. Operation timing excludes fixture and HTTP server setup; actual HTTP response and body are checked. Git subprocess launches and Path read-return bytes have stated exclusions. Summary means and ranges match trials; three trials support neither tail latency nor speedup conclusions.

Retaining current behavior and investigating immutable commit/path reuse only within a single invocation are proportionate to measured repetition and source inspection. No product optimization, new dependency or cross-call cache is in the diff.
Frozen coordinator scope PASS is physical scope evidence only; known unknown-mode/takeover defects do not establish semantic acceptance. Controller READY is dispatch readiness, not acceptance.

DeferredMinors.scenario: git diff --check BASE C reports trailing whitespace in preserved pytest raw output and a blank EOF line in implementation-last-message.txt. These are evidence bytes rather than source formatting.
DeferredMinors.remediation: Preserve original raw evidence; if repository policy requires a clean diff-check, address the policy or presentation without modifying the original evidence.

limitations: Synthetic small Spike workloads and synthetic approvals/check outputs are not actual human review or external business acceptance.
Results characterize three samples on the recorded Linux environment only; not production latency, robust tail latency, a speedup proof, or a Git versus FS equivalence.
Bytes cover Path.read_bytes and encoded Path.read_text returns, excluding Git subprocess, other file, kernel and socket I/O; HTTP was stdlib integration, not browser/UI acceptance.
Inventory readiness is BLOCKED for completed cards while acceptance is PASS; readiness is not conflated with acceptance.
Full suite, Windows, deployment, actual external business and whole iteration are outside this review.
independent_review.approval_scope: Whole task08 candidate C against unchanged BASE contract and goal only. This review does not register D, execute local strict, or approve the iteration, release, deployment, merge or push.
